As a new user (less than 6 months), their experience with fundamental tasks like importing and categorizing prospects will heavily influence their ease-of-use perception. While Pipedrive is generally known for its user-friendly interface, data import can sometimes be a point of friction for any CRM, especially if source data is not perfectly formatted or if complex field mapping is required.
